en.title: Place a Word in a Complete Horizontal or Vertical Slot
en.description:
The grid contains # (walls), _ (fillable cells), and lowercase letters. A word may only be written left to right or top to bottom. It must fill an entire contiguous segment delimited by the border or by #, and existing letters must match. The original grid example does not fit the character domain in the statement, so this site provides valid examples of its own.

The standard input/output is compiled by CSWork; numeric ranges marked as this site's are this site's judging conventions.
en.input: The first line contains r c, followed by r lines of the grid, and a final line with the word. This site's ranges: 1≤r,c≤500, word length 1..500, lowercase letters only.
en.output: Output 1 if the word can be placed, otherwise output 0.
en.explanation: Example 1: the horizontal segment containing ala has length 4, and the word cannot occupy only its first three cells; no other complete segment matches either, so the output is 0. Example 2: the third row is exactly alan, so the output is 1. Example 3: the first column c_t fully matches cat, so the output is 1.
hints: Split every row and every column at #; check only the segments whose length equals the word's, confirming character by character that each cell is empty or holds the target letter.
